entities.summary: Kyle Duerr Seager is an American former professional baseball third baseman who played his entire career for the Seattle Mariners of Major League Baseball (MLB) from 2011 to 2021. He was selected by the Mariners in the third round of the 2009 MLB draft and made his MLB debut in 2011. In 2014, he was an All Star and won a Gold Glove Award.
